source_instruction: i'm looking for a toothpaste for teeth whitening in blueberry scent
query:
Man, I swear the walk over here was way wilder than I planned it to be. I stopped to watch a group of elementary school kids chasing a runaway tabby cat that had stolen a whole cheese stick right out of one kid’s lunch bag, and they were all yelling so loud a barista from the corner shop came out holding a little bowl of tuna to try to coax the cat down from a fire hydrant. I ended up standing there for almost ten minutes laughing because the cat kept darting just out of reach every time someone got close, like it thought this was the best game ever. The cat finally dropped the half-eaten cheese stick and trotted right over to the barista like it hadn’t just caused a whole neighborhood commotion, it was so silly.
Hey, can you help me pick out a toothpaste here? I need one that does tooth desensitizing, I want the blueberry flavor, and oh, make sure it has the American Dental Association accepted seal on it too. I don’t want to go over a reasonable price, nothing too expensive, yeah? Let me know what options you’ve got that fit.
